upstream_sync.scope: Disjoint administrator/taxonomy UI and build checks; Python/runtime/tests/catalog exports unchanged.

prior_frontend_qualification.scope: Version0.67 actual exported runtime and browser integration checks, exact release-policy tests and both Node22.23.3 build profiles after numerical source changes. UI sources remain byte-identical to adopted0.66 baseline.

independent_package.scope: Experimental version 0.67.0 exact lean bytes in standalone/application wheels; minimum NumPy-only standalone test suite, uninstall ownership, aliases, checkpoint resume and fresh-process lazy activation pickle. Not an installed full-application dependency gate or a release.

frontend.scope: Complete current frontend suite after disjoint administrator/taxonomy upstream sync, plus driver/policy/two Node22.23.3 build profiles. All .67 numerical/runtime/application-Python and export bytes preserve their completed full CPU/WASM proof.

runtime_identity.scope: 18 runtime assets including 13 lock-hashed package wheels; actual Node core assets and Chrome fixture assets agree with public runtime.

formal_provenance.scope: Frozen formal .66 A versus experimental B numerical implementations, followed by explicit byte/version equivalence to release0.67 plus fresh package and Node/Chrome contracts. Does not relabel old runs as newly collected0.67 latency samples.

performance.scope: Four serial fresh CPU/Node/Chrome children each. Actual frozen validated 0.66 APIs compared with exact isolated lean candidate bytes (still version 0.66.0 by design). 100 determinant/log/graph +44 inverse/JVP/matmul/complex +26 existing GroupNorm/classification workflows per child. Common calibrated >=20ms batches, alternating variant order, complete raw samples preserved. Earlier alternative cleanup variants and A/A CPU controls remain separate evidence. No native-Torch/GPU latency, browser heap, cold start, universal speedup or main integration claim.

longer_outlier_controls.scope: Longer targeted follow-up to 12x170 full series. Four fresh CPU/Node children each, rotating import order, twelve balanced three-way common >=50ms batches, matched inputs and pre-timing value/gradient checks. Same-source A/A is explicitly recorded, not subtracted to manufacture speedup. Input alignment metadata is observational; no causal alignment, native-Torch timing, Chrome replication or universal speed claim. Original full-series outliers remain unchanged.

actual_inverse.scope: Warm incremental CPU tracemalloc forward retained/peak and separately traced weighted backward peaks against actual 0.66 APIs. C primals; explicit C/F two-dimensional directions and C/interleaved batched directions; actual element strides and expected native-compatible direction-copy predicate are recorded per row. Inputs/directions/weights predate tracing. The optional shared-route override exercises WASM routing on CPU as an allocation proxy, with its override recorded explicitly. Not total tape bytes, RSS, LAPACK workspace or WASM heap.

forced_shared_cpu_proxy.scope: Warm incremental CPU tracemalloc forward retained/peak and separately traced weighted backward peaks against actual 0.66 APIs. C primals; explicit C/F two-dimensional directions and C/interleaved batched directions; actual element strides and expected native-compatible direction-copy predicate are recorded per row. Inputs/directions/weights predate tracing. The optional shared-route override exercises WASM routing on CPU as an allocation proxy, with its override recorded explicitly. Not total tape bytes, RSS, LAPACK workspace or WASM heap.

callback_cleanup.scope: Warm whole-call incremental CPU tracemalloc retained/peak, not backward-only, RSS, LAPACK workspace or browser heap. Existing official fixtures validate independent values/gradients before tracing; operands and pre-existing stored gradients predate tracing. Three balanced variant orders. This is a memory observation, not a latency benchmark.

public_benchmark_validation.scope: Validation-only mode omits timing. Otherwise 26 matched existing 0.66 GroupNorm/classification controls, using frozen official fixtures and their independent composition/float64 formula checks. Actual library current/baseline APIs are timed, never those references. Both dtypes and active/frozen affine/input patterns; five alternating common >=20ms batches. Shapes/fixtures/seeds precede timing; full calls include graph creation, kernels, reduction/backward/clearing/destruction, or no-grad forward when marked. No native-Torch or GPU timing claim.

prior_native_api.scope: All 40 repository test_torch_*.py native API comparison modules against isolated lean stridetorch bytes on PYTHONPATH. This does not claim application packaging, catalog export, frontend or full PaperLeet exercise integration.

jvp_qualification.scope: 696 native 2.14.1 determinant JVP controls; real float32/64, C/F/sliced inputs/directions, all four requires-grad pairs, primal/tangent/reverse/stored gradients and returned-primal hooks. Finite componentwise tolerance float32 2e-5 / float64 3e-12; float32 matrix gradients for n>=8 use per-matrix max-norm relative bound 1e-5 to handle near-zero entries. NaN/Inf masks are exact. Singleton zero signs are exact. Ordinary det singular-cofactor semantics are checked separately.

inverse_qualification.scope: Inverse real JVP and both reverse channels, complex forward, native final-axis strides, empty/singleton/extreme inputs, exact nonfinite masks, native mutation states and legacy input= alias. Matrix components at n>=8 use per-matrix/component max-norm float32/complex64 1e-5 or float64/complex128 3e-12; other finite values use componentwise float32 3e-5 / float64 3e-12, atol=0. No complex AD or output buffers.

inverse_target_qualification.scope: Exact frozen native partial-target/reuse/retained-gradient/hooks/mutation states and meaningful raw/stored strides; C/F/interleaved directions, 2x2/32x32, batched and empty groups. All IEEE masks exact; finite large matrices use explicit per-matrix relative max norm bounds, small matrices use componentwise normal-input tolerances.

limitations: Real/complex supported API and higher-derivative boundaries are unchanged; this does not add a GPU backend.

Formal timing used frozen A and B0.66 builds; B numerical/graph files exactly match versioned0.67, whose only difference is the version literal. Old timing samples are not relabeled as fresh0.67 runs.
